technique_name: Explain the significance of the Battle of Gettysburg.
description: The Battle of Gettysburg was an important battle during the American Civil War, fought between the Union and the Confederate armies in Gettysburg, Pennsylvania on July 1–3, 1863. It was a pivotal battle which resulted in heavy losses; the Union lost an estimated 23,000 men, while the Confederate was estimated to be 28,000 men.
